talents.name: Improved Wrath
descriptions: Reduces the cast time of your Wrath spell by 0 sec and its Mana cost by 50%.

talents.name: Genesis
descriptions: Increases the periodic damage and healing done by your spells and abilities by 1%.

talents.name: Moonglow
descriptions: Reduces the Mana cost of your damaging spells by 25%.

talents.name: Improved Entangling Roots
descriptions: Increases the damage done by your Entangling Roots spell by 75%, and its victims can take up to 75% more damage without interrupting the effect.

talents.name: Nature's Majesty
descriptions: Increases your critical strike chance with spells and melee attacks by 1%.

talents.name: Nature's Splendor
descriptions: Increases the duration of your Moonfire and Rejuvenation spells by 3 sec, your Regrowth spell by 6 sec, and your Insect Swarm spell by 2 sec.

talents.name: Nature's Reach
descriptions: Increases the range of your offensive Balance spells by 20% and improves your chance to hit by 4%.

talents.name: Insect Swarm
descriptions: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit with attacks by 2% and causing 48 Nature damage over <!--sp1223083:0-->12 sec<!--sp1223083-->.

talents.name: Improved Moonfire
descriptions: Increases the damage and critical strike chance of your Moonfire spell by 2%.

talents.name: Vengeance
descriptions: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane and Nature spells by 20%.

talents.name: Improved Starfire
descriptions: Reduces the cast time of Starfire by 1 sec and Starfire has a 15% chance to stun its target for 3 sec.

talents.name: Nature's Grace
descriptions: All non-periodic spell criticals grace you with a blessing of nature, increasing your spellcasting speed and reducing your global cooldown by 10% for 3 sec.

talents.name: Eclipse
descriptions: Your Wrath spell reduces the cast time of your next 2 Starfire spells by 0.03 sec. Stores up to 4 charges. Lasts 15 sec.

talents.name: Moonfury
descriptions: Increases the damage done by your Arcane and Nature spells by 2%.

talents.name: Moonkin Form
descriptions:
Shapeshift into Moonkin Form, increasing Omen of Clarity's chance to trigger by 100%, Armor contribution from items by 360%, and all party members within 45 yards have their Critical Strike chance increased by 3%, exclusive with Leader of the Pack. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and prevents the use of healing spells.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

talents.name: Overgrowth
descriptions: Increases the maximum number of targets you may have affected by Entangling Roots by 2.

talents.name: Ferocity
descriptions: Reduces the cost of your Maul, Primal Bite, Swipe, Claw, and Rake abilities by 1 Rage or Energy.

talents.name: Heart of the Wild
descriptions: Increases your Intellect by 10%.  In addition, while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form your Stamina is increased by 20% and while in Cat Form your Strength is increased by 10%.

talents.name: Feral Instinct
descriptions: Increases damage done by your Swipe ability by 3% and reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while Prowling as if you were 1 <!--singular:level:levels-->levels<!--singular--> higher.

talents.name: Brutal Impact
descriptions: Increases the stun duration of your Bash and Pounce abilities by 1 sec and reduces the cooldown of Bash by 30 sec.

talents.name: Thick Hide
descriptions: While in Bear Form, Cat Form, Dire Bear Form, or Moonkin Form, you gain <!--ppl1:60:3:300-->180 additional base Armor per level and another 1.00 base Armor for each point of defense skill beyond five times your level. This amount can be further increased by multipliers from those forms.

talents.name: Feral Swiftness
descriptions: Increases your movement speed while in Cat Form by 30%, and increases your chance to Dodge by 4%.

talents.name: Feral Charge
descriptions:
Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
Charge an enemy, immobilizing them and interrupting any spell they are casting for 4 sec.


Feral Charge (Cat)
8 - 25 yd range
Instant30 sec cooldown
Requires Druid
Requires level 1
Requires Cat Form
Leap behind an enemy.

talents.name: Shredding Attacks
descriptions: Reduces the Energy cost of your Shred ability by 6 and reduces the Rage cost of your Lacerate ability by 6.

talents.name: Sharpened Claws
descriptions: Increases your critical strike chance while in Bear Form, Dire Bear Form, or Cat Form by 2%.

talents.name: Blood Frenzy
descriptions: Gives you a 100% chance to gain an additional 5 Rage any time you get a critical strike while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. In addition, your non-periodic critical strikes from Cat Form abilities that generate Combo Points have a 0% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

talents.name: Savage Fury
descriptions: Increases the damage caused by your Claw, Rake, Shred, Maul, and Swipe abilities by 20%.

talents.name: Primal Bite
descriptions: Bite the target, dealing 100% normal damage plus 26 and generating a high amount of threat.<!--cooldown:417141:until canceled-->

talents.name: Natural Instinct
descriptions: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your melee abilities by 20% and increases your spell healing by 25% of your Intellect.

talents.name: Shifting Power
descriptions: Instantly convert 0 Mana into 40 Energy. Shifting Power's cost is reduced by effects that reduce the cost of Shapeshifting.

talents.name: Predatory Strikes
descriptions: Increases your melee Attack Power in Cat Form, Bear Form, and Dire Bear Form by 50% of your level.

talents.name: Rend and Tear
descriptions: Increases damage done by your melee abilities on Bleeding targets by 20%.

talents.name: Natural Reaction
descriptions: Increases your dodge chance by 0%, and gives you a 3% chance to gain 5 Rage each time you dodge.

talents.name: Leader of the Pack
descriptions: While in Cat Form, Bear Form, or Dire Bear Form, the Leader of the Pack increases the critical strike chance of all party members within 45 yards by 3%, exclusive with Moonkin Aura.

talents.name: Berserk
descriptions:
Requires Cat Form, Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
Causes your Primal Bite ability to strike up to 3 targets, removes its cooldown, and increases the critical strike chance of your Combo Point-generating abilities by 100%. Clears and grants immunity to Fear effects for the duration. Lasts 15 sec.

talents.name: Improved Shifting Power
descriptions: Reduces the cooldown of your Shifting Power spell by 0 sec.

talents.name: Improved Tranquility
descriptions: Reduces threat caused by Tranquility by 100% and its cooldown by 60%.

talents.name: Wild Growth
descriptions: Heals the target and their party for 336 over 7 sec. Party members must be within 43.5 yards of target. The amount healed is applied quickly at first, and slows down as Wild Growth reaches its full duration.

talents.name: Living Spirit
descriptions: Increases your Spirit by 15%.

talents.name: Swiftmend
descriptions: Instantly heals a target with an active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for an amount equal to the full duration of the periodic effect of one of those spells.

talents.name: Improved Regrowth
descriptions: Increases the critical effect chance of your Regrowth spell by 10%.

talents.name: Improved Rejuvenation
descriptions: Increases the effect of your Rejuvenation spell by 5%.

talents.name: Tranquil Spirit
descriptions: Reduces the mana cost of your Healing Touch and Tranquility spells by 2%.

talents.name: Gift of Nature
descriptions: Increases the effect of all your healing spells by 2%.

talents.name: Reflection
descriptions: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Gift of the Earthmother
descriptions: Reduces the global cooldown by 0.5 seconds on your Rejuvenation, Swiftmend, and Wild Growth spells.

talents.name: Natural Shapeshifter
descriptions: Reduces the mana cost of all shapeshifting by 10%.

talents.name: Subtlety
descriptions: Reduces the threat generated by your Nature and Arcane spells by 30%.

talents.name: Nature's Swiftness
descriptions: When activated, your next Nature spell becomes an instant cast spell.

talents.name: Naturalist
descriptions: Reduces the cast time of your Healing Touch spell by 0 sec and increases all damage you deal by 100%.

talents.name: Nature's Focus
descriptions: Gives you a 14% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting Arcane and Nature spells.

talents.name: Furor
descriptions:
Gives you a 20% chance to gain 10 Rage when shapeshifting into Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. Shapeshifting into Cat Form restores 20% of the Energy you had when last in Cat Form, plus 2 Energy per sec spent outside Cat Form, up to 20 Energy.

Bear Form and Dire Bear Form forfeit this Energy and halt its restoration while active.
